name: ASTARTES
text: In each activation a friendly Plague Marine may take two Shoot actions or two Fight actions. Two Shoots need a boltgun, a bolt pistol or a PSYCHIC weapon among them, and the same PSYCHIC ranged weapon cannot be picked twice. Every Plague Marine can counteract whatever its order.

name: Disgustingly Resilient
text: Whenever one attack die would deal 3 or more damage to a friendly Plague Marine, roll a D6: on a 4 or more that die deals 1 less. Poison, Flail, Hot, Curse of Rot and other damage that does not come from an attack die is never reduced.

name: Poison
text: If any of your successes deal damage with this weapon, the target (unless it is a friendly Plague Marine) gains one of your Poison tokens, if it has none. Whenever an operative with one of your Poison tokens is activated, it takes 1 damage.
source: wahapedia kill-teams plague-marines; docs/spec/13-teams.md T-PM.17, T-PM.18

name: Toxic
text: Against an enemy that already had one of your Poison tokens when the action began, add 1 to both Dmg values of this weapon. This is checked for each target on its own.

name: PSYCHIC
text: A tag with no effect of its own. Rules such as Astartes read it to know which weapons are psychic.

name: Grandfather's Blessing
text: When an enemy carrying one of your Poison tokens loses wounds within 7 inches of the Champion, the Champion regains that many wounds, up to 3 wounds per turning point and never above its starting wounds. It does nothing once the Champion is incapacitated.

name: Grenadier
text: The Bombardier carries its own blight and krak grenades at Hit 3+, and its blight grenades have Toxic. They do not use any grenade uses the team picked from equipment.

name: FLAIL
text: Every other operative, friend or foe, that the Fighter can see within 2 inches takes D3+2 damage, rolled separately. An enemy whose D3 was a 3 also gains one of your Poison tokens if it has none. It counts as a Fight action for action limits and for Astartes, and needs no enemy in control range. Not with a Conceal order.

name: Icon Bearer
text: When control of a marker is worked out, this operative counts as having 1 more APL. This is not an APL change, so it adds to real APL changes.

name: Icon of Contagion
text: While this operative is in your opponent's territory, the Contagion strategy ploy costs you 0 CP.

name: POISONOUS MIASMA
text: Pick an enemy that is visible and within 7 inches, or one that is a valid target for the Plaguecaster at any range. It gains one of your Poison tokens if it has none; if it already has one it takes 3 damage instead. Not while in an enemy control range.

name: PUTRESCENT VITALITY
text: Pick a friendly operative that is visible and within 3 inches (the Plaguecaster itself counts) and roll 2D6. On a total of 7 it regains 7 wounds; otherwise it regains wounds equal to the higher die. Not while in an enemy control range, and only once per turning point.

name: Repulsive Fortitude
text: When this operative is shot, its defence dice that roll 5 or more are critical successes.
